purpose: Do v52's member weights (combination 0.40, masked 0.40), chosen on 2025's natural adsb.lol coverage, still hold when the ADS-B inputs come from the scored months' coverage regime? Read at the network-table level on December 2025 with its inputs as they are and thinned to January 2026's coverage (coverage-regime attempt a13: EDDF).
scope_limits: December only: the July leave-one-month-out models of the base networks (e24, e24b, e32) kept their predictions but not their model files, so July (EDDF / LSZH under July 2026's regime) cannot be re-predicted on the footing the development table used. December's thinning changes EDDF only. The committee and the rest of the stack are not re-predicted: this is the network table, where the member weights act.
disclosed: Known before this declaration: the member-weight round (configs/member_weights_v1.json, null; best c40_m70 -0.013% on natural development months), the positional batch (docs/adsb_ctx3_pos/: the thinning penalty on the context network is +19.6% on EDDF / LSZH rows, EDDF December 94.3 -> 128.1 s for ref32 design-fold models), and the official scores of v51 / v52. No thinned prediction of the models below exists yet.

members.combo_all: dl32 seed mean on rows with adsb_matched = 1, m25dl32 seed mean on the others
members.mask_unmatched: m25_32 seed mean on rows with adsb_matched = 0, empty on matched rows
members.routing: each regime routes by its own adsb_matched (a row that loses its match under thinning goes to m25dl32 and the masked member)

inputs.natural: the December build (data/december/d198dea10625b0a75977) + the tables every refit run read (runs/adsb_ctx2/inputs/adsb_features_arcw0, data/external/adsblol/features_v19; hashes checked against the runs' records) + tokens data/ctx/tokens_v1
inputs.thinned: the same December rows with runs/coverage_regime/a13_dec/features/thinned/{committee,v19} and tokens data/ctx/tokens_thin_a13/2025-12 (rebuilt from the thinned pass-2 matches); every other input unchanged
inputs.device: workstation CPU for both regimes (GPU-trained models predicted on CPU, as the final-file runner does)

table: T(c, m) = (1 - m) [(1 - c) nets + c combo_all] + m mask_unmatched where each member has a value (non-LIRF rows); LIRF rows unchanged
checks_before_any_candidate: each learner's CPU prediction of December with natural inputs against its own recorded december_predictions.parquet: RMS at most 0.01 s for the CPU-trained e24 / e24b, at most 0.25 s for the GPU-trained e32 and members
the natural nets table (0.25 e24 + 0.25 e24b + 0.5 e32) against the December nets column of runs/lomo_dev/rows.parquet: RMS at most 0.25 s
readings: table RMSE on non-LIRF December departures and on EDDF, natural and thinned, per candidate; change against c40_m40 in each regime; paired-day 95% intervals (December days) of the thinned change, whole month and EDDF; matched / unmatched split
decision: A candidate shifts the weights when, on thinned inputs, its whole-month non-LIRF table RMSE is at least 0.05% below c40_m40's and the paired-day interval of that difference lies below zero. The lowest such thinned RMSE is carried forward to a separately declared follow-up (the stack with the committee also on thinned inputs, then the usual January / July / December development reading) before any export; every upload stays the user's decision. Without such a candidate, v52's weights stand for the January 2026 regime.
labels_read: December 2025 only (a development month). No ranking row, official score or published aggregate.
